problems: e1: clip ↔ clip is not a compatible pair
notes: Minifigure (head, torso, legs, helmet and torch) is not in the parts list, so it is not a node.
The booklet shows only some steps' parts boxes. Many connections (which plate sits on which, ports used) are inferred from the pictures, so ports are mostly null.

Item identities are inferred where several pieces look alike. The red front tow lights are taken as lego-2540. Dynamite is clipped to the 61252 clip plate holding the gauge tile. Pickaxe and drill rest in the crate. The jackhammer is clipped to a vertical-clip brick.
The parts list sums to 100 pieces by line quantities, not the stated 97. All listed lines are included.
The four wheels are a repeat. Copies 1-2 attach to wheel holder b26 and copies 3-4 to b27 (override).
Loose crystals and round plates inside the boulder are modelled as contact with the bottom half. The top half snaps on.
The warning sign (b1-b3) rests in the crate (contact b3-b10), as on pages 5 and 24, so it is part of the truck group.

The boulder (b13-b22) is intentionally a separate group. Page 5 builds it as its own free-standing model: crystals and plates go in the bottom half and the top half snaps on. Page 24 shows it only standing beside the truck, never attached. Linking it to the truck would invent a connection the booklet does not show, so the 2-group warning is not a real problem here.
